info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v5-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Classes API provides access to a comprehensive list of fitness classes available to members. This API enables users to explore different class offerings, including schedules, instructors, and class types. It's particularly useful for gym operators, fitness enthusiasts, and developers creating fitness-related applications. By retrieving detailed information about classes, users can make informed decisions about their fitness schedules and memberships.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of class memberships.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all available class memberships for users. It provides details on each class, including eligibility, availability, and any associated fees. Ideal for users looking to explore or enroll in classes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a list of membership classes. Ensure to provide all necessary criteria for filtering the classes, if applicable.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of membership classes.
